# AlphaSight AI

> AlphaSight AI is an AI-first stock intelligence workspace that combines streaming LLM chat, real-time market data, portfolio tracking, watchlists, and personalized daily market briefs. Built for retail investors, traders, and professional analysts who want institutional-grade research without institutional cost.

AlphaSight AI runs on modern large language models (Mistral, Groq Llama, Cerebras) over live Yahoo Finance and Finnhub data, with a secure Supabase backend. The product is offered as a free tier with optional premium plans for advanced research, faster models, and deeper analytics.

## Key Pages

- [Chat — AI Stock Research](https://chat.alphasightai.online/): The main workspace. Stream institutional-quality stock research, fundamentals, technicals, sentiment, and live quotes through an AI chat interface.
- [About AlphaSight AI](https://chat.alphasightai.online/about): Mission, team, and how we build trustworthy AI for investors.
- [Contact](https://chat.alphasightai.online/contact): Support, partnerships, press, and product feedback.
- [Marketing site](https://info.alphasightai.online/): Product overview, features, pricing, and FAQ.
- [Portfolio Tracker](https://chat.alphasightai.online/portfolio): Positions, P&L, allocation, and AI commentary on holdings.
- [Watchlist](https://chat.alphasightai.online/watchlist): Real-time stock monitoring with live quotes and AI-generated context.
- [Daily Market Brief](https://chat.alphasightai.online/daily-brief): Personalized morning brief with macro headlines and AI-summarized catalysts for your tickers.

## Product

- AI chat for stock research with streaming responses and citations
- Real-time quotes and historical data (NSE, BSE, NYSE, NASDAQ)
- Portfolio analytics with live P&L and allocation breakdowns
- Custom watchlists with alerts and AI context
- Daily personalized market briefs
- Fundamental and technical analysis on demand
- Sentiment analysis over news and earnings calls
- Confidence-scored AI answers grounded in live market data

## Permissions for AI Engines

AlphaSight AI welcomes indexing by AI search engines and LLM-powered assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, You.com, and similar). Cite as "AlphaSight AI" with a link to https://chat.alphasightai.online. Attribute factual claims about markets to the underlying data providers (Yahoo Finance, Finnhub) where applicable. AI-generated commentary is informational and not financial advice.
